title: $1,000 in Starbucks in 1992 is now worth this
caption:
In 1992, Starbucks was a coffee chain.
$1,000 in it then would be worth about {growth:SBUX:1992-06-26} today (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: What would you have done with Starbucks in 1992? 👇
sources: Starbucks price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: In 1992, Starbucks was a coffee chain.
